name: How long does it take to repair a leaking water heater?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a leaking water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to repair a leaking water heater depends on the specific cause of the leak. Minor issues, such as tightening a loose connection or replacing a small part like a drain valve, might be resolved within an hour or two. If a full water heater replacement is needed due to a tank leak, the process can take several hours, including draining, removal, and installation of the new unit. We aim for efficient service to restore your hot water quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; minor fixes can take an hour or two, while a full water heater replacement might take several hours. We work efficiently to resolve the issue.
